scratch_pool.description: Transient scratch collections: ObjectPool/ListPool free lists and the pooled lists or formula-argument dictionaries rented and returned within one call. They hold no game state and are what the game itself does for every formula evaluation and range query.
scratch_pool.observer_guarantee: Calls run on the Unity main thread only (pools are not thread-safe); pooled objects are returned by the game method before it returns; the observer passes its own buffers where the API accepts one.

guarded_actor_component_cache.description: Actor.Get(Type) inserts into the actor's private component-map cache when the type is missing.
guarded_actor_component_cache.observer_guarantee: Before every call that reaches Actor.Get the observer checks with ReflectionTable.ActorComponentCached (Actor._componentMap.ContainsKey) that the component type is already cached, and skips the value otherwise (ReadLayer.Guard). Actor.Awake pre-fills the map, so the insert path is never taken.

unreachable_lazy_init.description: One-time lazy initialization of singletons and registries (manager InitializeSingletonInstance, GameData runtime clone and manifest registration).
unreachable_lazy_init.observer_guarantee: The observer reads game managers and GameData only in the READY state (lifecycle gate), after Awake of every scene manager has resolved its singleton and after boot created GameData.instance; these initialization paths run only when the singleton is unresolved.
